phase_4_decision.section_chunk_diagnostics: B2a improves final gold-span diagnostics over B1 on five dev questions; independent quality/generalization gain not established.
phase_4_decision.hierarchy_expansion: Interleaving bounded neighbors reduces final gold-span coverage despite unchanged candidate group coverage. Retain as an experimental configuration; do not enable by default.
phase_4_decision.default_configuration: Unchanged dense-20, reranking off; B2a is the better measured structural configuration.
